project: NFS Underground Remastered (Pixel fork of Android Evolved)
approach: Static x86-to-C recompilation with pcrecomp; Win32 compatibility runtime and Direct3D 9 through DXVK/Vulkan on Android.
notes: Personal fork of codepdbh/nfsu1-recompiled for a Pixel 10 Pro XL: ARM64 only, English launcher, native-resolution/120 FPS defaults, anisotropic filtering and MSAA options, in-app game import and diagnostics, GitHub Actions build. Original PC game data required.
